settings.name: ReserveConnectorZeroSupported
settings.meaning: whether the whole station can be reserved at once; cpms always reserves one EVSE, so this is informational

settings.name: AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests
settings.meaning: if true, the station asks cpms to Authorize the tag of a remote start; cpms accepts only auth.default_id_tag

settings.name: LocalAuthListEnabled
settings.meaning: if true, a whitelist held on the station can let tags charge without asking cpms

settings.name: LocalPreAuthorize
settings.meaning: if true, the station starts at once for tags it knows locally, before cpms answers

settings.name: LocalAuthorizeOffline
settings.meaning: if true, the station lets tags it knows locally charge while cpms is unreachable

settings.name: NumberOfConnectors
settings.meaning: how many connectors the station has; checked against the EVSEs in config

settings.name: HeartbeatInterval
settings.meaning: seconds between heartbeats; cpms sets it at boot from charger.heartbeat_interval

settings.name: ConnectionTimeOut
settings.meaning: seconds the station waits for a cable after a remote start or a presented tag

settings.name: MeterValueSampleInterval
settings.meaning: seconds between meter values during a session; 0 means none are sent
